Syndra

the Dark Sovereign

Syndra conjures dark spheres and turns them into weapons. She pokes with them, stuns with them, and her ultimate throws all of them at one target for huge burst. She takes practice, but she can dominate lanes and delete carries late game.

When to pick Syndra

✗ Better as a counter-pick

Better picked later. She has no dash, so assassins like Fizz and Katarina punish a blind pick.

Pick into

  • Immobile mages she out-trades with long-range poke, like Cassiopeia and Orianna
  • Squishy carries she can one-shot with Unleashed Power, like Jinx or Xerath
  • Divers who walk in a line toward her stun, like Darius or Garen
  • Teams with one key carry you need to delete

Avoid into

  • Assassins who dodge her stun and jump on her, like Fizz, Katarina and Ekko
  • Very tanky teams where her single-target burst doesn't kill anyone
  • Teams with lots of magic resist or Banshee's Veil

Great teammates

ViVi locks a target in place so Syndra's spheres and stun hit.
SejuaniSejuani's stuns give Syndra time to land her full combo.
ThreshThresh's hook pulls a target in for Syndra's burst.

Your team needs: Pick Syndra when your team has a frontline and peel, so assassins can't jump on her.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Massive single-target burst with her ultimate
  • Strong lane control and long-range poke
  • Q + E stun sets up kills and stops divers
  • Splinters upgrade her abilities over the game, so she scales very well

Weaknesses

  • No dash: assassins and divers are a big problem
  • Her stun takes practice to land consistently
  • Has to manage spheres and their positions
  • Can run low on mana if she pokes too much early

Power spikes

  • Level 3: Q + E stun lets you punish anyone who walks up.
  • Level 6: Unleashed Power makes you a kill threat whenever you have spheres down.
  • First item (Luden's Echo): stronger poke and burst.
  • Three items (Rabadon's Deathcap): one combo kills most squishy champions.

Top tips

  • Put spheres down before your ultimate for more damage.
  • Practice the Q → E stun until it's automatic.
  • Stay far back: Syndra has no dash.
  • Trade often to collect splinters.
  • Use W to throw minions when no sphere is around.
  • Save E to stop divers from reaching you.
